## `listProviderRegions`

Get provider region availability

| Property        | Value                                                                           |
| --------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| HTTP            | `GET` `/v1/providers/{provider}/regions`                                        |
| SDK method      | `device.listProviderRegions(request, execution?)`                               |
| SDK return type | `Promise<ApiResult<OperationData<DeviceApiOperations["listProviderRegions"]>>>` |
| Authentication  | `X-Api-Key` (injected by the client)                                            |
| Mutability      | `read`                                                                          |
| Automatic retry | Safe retries enabled                                                            |

### Parameters

| SDK field              | Location | Required | Type           | Example      | Constraints                                                                                | Description                                                                                |
| ---------------------- | -------- | -------- | -------------- | ------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `params.path.provider` | path     | Yes      | `ProviderName` | `"telegram"` | enum="telegram", "whatsapp", "line", "twitter", "x", "zalo", "tiktok", "whatsapp_protocol" | The provider name. Actual availability depends on the capabilities of the current account. |

### Request body

No request body.

### Responses

| HTTP status | Content-Type       | Schema                  | Description                                                                 |
| ----------- | ------------------ | ----------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `200`       | `application/json` | `ResponseMeta & object` | Regions supported by the provider and whether each region can be allocated. |
| `400`       | `application/json` | `ErrorEnvelope`         | The request body or parameters are invalid.                                 |
| `401`       | `application/json` | `ErrorEnvelope`         | The API key is missing or cannot be validated.                              |
| `500`       | `application/json` | `ErrorEnvelope`         | An internal server error or an unmapped error in the provider integration.  |

The SDK returns `ApiResult<T>` with `data`, `status`, an optional `requestId`, and the underlying `response`.

Success status `200` response fields:

| Field                                    | Present | Type                        | Constraints                                                                                | Description                                                                                |
| ---------------------------------------- | ------- | --------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `result.data.request_id`                 | No      | `string`                    | -                                                                                          | The request ID generated by the server.                                                    |
| `result.data.client_request_id`          | No      | `string`                    | -                                                                                          | Echoed when the client supplies a valid `X-Request-Id` request header.                     |
| `result.data.data`                       | Yes     | `ProviderRegionsResponse`   | -                                                                                          | -                                                                                          |
| `result.data.data.provider`              | Yes     | `ProviderName`              | enum="telegram", "whatsapp", "line", "twitter", "x", "zalo", "tiktok", "whatsapp_protocol" | The provider name. Actual availability depends on the capabilities of the current account. |
| `result.data.data.regions`               | Yes     | `Array<RegionAvailability>` | -                                                                                          | -                                                                                          |
| `result.data.data.regions[].region`      | Yes     | `string`                    | -                                                                                          | -                                                                                          |
| `result.data.data.regions[].supported`   | Yes     | `boolean`                   | -                                                                                          | -                                                                                          |
| `result.data.data.regions[].allocatable` | Yes     | `boolean`                   | -                                                                                          | -                                                                                          |

```ts

  params: {
```
